LTTH Version 1.3.25 Release Notes

Version 1.3.25 keeps the Windows path on launcher.exe, routes app-store auth through the ltth.app website bridge, and keeps launcher-driven updates and rollback handling intact.

- IMPROVED: App store auth now uses the ltth.app website Clerk bridge and local callback handoff instead of loading Clerk directly inside the desktop app
- FIXED: Windows desktop shortcuts now prefer the LTTH launcher icon instead of falling back to the generic favicon
- IMPROVED: Public release metadata and download surfaces bumped to 1.3.25
